# Molar

> Molar (also called Molar QA, at molar.it) is an AI QA and browser automation platform for web applications. Its browser agents test customer journeys in a real browser and return pass or fail with screenshots, a recording and an exported Playwright test. Stateful clones of services such as Stripe, Twilio, email and sign-in let those flows run without live vendor accounts, and a CLI and MCP server let coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor check their own changes. Molar is in beta and free during the beta. It is unrelated to dental molars or the chemistry unit of the same name.

## Key facts
- Category: AI QA testing, browser agent, browser automation, Playwright test generation, service clones for end-to-end tests.
- Products: Cartographer (explore an app and record a check), Clones (stateful Stripe, Twilio, email, sign-in and storage stand-ins), Guard (checks on pull requests and on a schedule), Trace (step-by-step run debugging), Mender (proposed fixes, preview).
- Pricing: free during the beta, up to 25 hosted runs a day per organization, no card. See https://molar.it/pricing.
- Install: `npm install -g @molar/cli`, then `molar login` and `molar verify "login works" --url http://localhost:3000 --json`.
- MCP server for coding agents: https://api.molar.it/mcp (Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http molar https://api.molar.it/mcp`).
- Documentation: https://docs.molar.it
- Built by Pratik Rana in Bengaluru, India (operating as Molar Labs).

This map is generated from crawlable canonical HTML pages. Product availability and coverage depend on the configured environment; the linked pages are the source of truth.

## Platform
- [Molar Platform — Browser Execution for Humans & AI Agents](https://molar.it/platform) — Give your team and AI agents a browser that gets work done. Automate tasks, explore apps, extract data and inspect the result with Molar.
- [Browser Agent: Run Web Tasks in a Real Browser | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/browser-agents) — Give Molar a website and a task. It works through the site in a real browser and returns the result, with a recording of every step.
- [CLI, MCP Server & API for Coding Agents | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/developer-tools) — Install the molar CLI, connect Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client, or call the HTTP API. Every check returns JSON your coding agent can read.
- [Live View & Recordings for Browser Agent Runs | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/live-view) — Watch a hosted run live, read-only, then replay its video, screenshots, network log and Playwright trace.
- [Multi-User Browser Tests Across Accounts (Preview) | Molar](https://molar.it/platform/swarm) — Preview: test one flow across several accounts, with a separate browser and identity for each role, such as an admin inviting a member.

## Products
- [Cartographer: AI Agent to Map & Test Web Apps | Molar](https://molar.it/products/cartographer) — Cartographer is Molar’s browser agent. It explores an authorized web app, follows tasks like sign-up in a real browser, and returns a check you can rerun.
- [Clones: Stateful Stripe, Twilio & Email Mocks | Molar](https://molar.it/products/clones) — Molar Clones are stateful stand-ins for Stripe, Twilio, email, sign-in and storage. Point your tests at a clone instead of the live vendor, then reset the data.
- [Guard: Browser Checks Before Merge & After Release | Molar](https://molar.it/products/guard) — Molar Guard runs your sign-up, checkout and account checks on pull requests, preview deployments and a schedule, and shows the step that failed.
- [Mender: Reviewable Fixes for Failed Checks (Preview) | Molar](https://molar.it/products/mender) — Mender, in preview, takes a reproducible Guard failure and its Trace, prepares a proposed change for review, and waits for a person to approve it.
- [Trace: Debug Failed Browser Tests Step by Step | Molar](https://molar.it/products/trace) — Molar Trace puts the browser action, page, request and service details of one run in sequence, so you can find the last good step and the cause of a failed test.

- [Test Team Invitations & Role Permissions | Molar](https://molar.it/solutions/team-workflows) — Test an invitation across two browsers: the admin screen, the email, the membership state and the permissions the new member receives.

- [Web Data Extraction with a Real Browser | Molar](https://molar.it/solutions/web-data-extraction) — Describe the fields you need from a web app you can access, such as plan names or invoice numbers, and get the values back as a structured result.
- [Browser Workflow Automation for Forms & Downloads | Molar](https://molar.it/solutions/workflow-automation) — Describe a repeat browser task such as finding an invoice, downloading a report or filling an approved form, and use the returned file or fields in your next tool.

## Interpretation
The interactive examples on the marketing site are labeled examples or controlled tests. They are not customer testimonials, reliability benchmarks, or guarantees of complete vendor parity. Read the relevant page and documentation before relying on a capability.
